name: 林含怡
objective: This course aims to develop students’ oral communication and presentation skills in English through thematic, interactive, and project-based learning. Students will learn to express and organize ideas, respond to others, ask follow-up questions, participate in discussions, and communicate effectively in a range of everyday and more formal contexts. Through pair and group activities, topic-based speaking tasks, and presentation projects, students will develop greater confidence and fluency in engaging in coherent and extended spoken exchanges in English. The course also serves as preparation for future coursework in professional English presentations and communication.
